note: Direct yield takes priority. Estimating density below is equivalent dry-material consumption inferred from bag mass and yield, not installed coating density. These estimating bases do not include site loss or replace the project's approved fire-protection specification.

products.basis: Reviewed 14 Sep 2026: Promat Australia CAFCO 300 TDS, Feb 2025, p4: 20 kg bags and nominal coverage 217 m²/tonne at 15 mm. Direct yield = 20/1000 × 217 × 0.015 = 65.10 L/bag. Estimating density is inferred dry-material consumption (mass/yield), not the published installed dry density of 310 kg/m³ ±15%. Actual site losses are additional; adjust yield or wastage to project evidence.
products.confidence: Published nominal coverage; allow for site loss.

products.basis: Reviewed 14 Sep 2026: Promat AU-hosted MANDOLITE CP2 PDS (Nov 2009), p2 coverage 172 m²/tonne at 15 mm; p4 Australian bag mass 20 kg. Direct yield = 51.60 L/bag. Estimating density is inferred dry-material consumption, not installed coating density. The Apr 2010 application guide gives conflicting higher coverage; retain this lower PDS basis provisionally and verify project/site yield. Wastage remains separate.
products.confidence: Provisional: published PDS and application-guide coverage conflict.

products.basis: Reviewed 14 Sep 2026: Promat FENDOLITE MII application guide (Sep 2008), PDF p15/printed p13, hosted by Ceasefire Australia: theoretical coverage 1.24 m² per 20 kg bag at 25 mm. Direct yield = 31.00 L/bag. Estimating density is inferred dry-material consumption, not installed coating density. This theoretical yield excludes wastage; retain project-specific loss allowances.

Reviewed 14 Sep 2026: Tremco Australia PERLIFOC HP ECO+ brochure (170821), p3: 17 kg bags; minimum consumption 3.5 kg/m²/cm. Direct yield = 17/350 = 48.57 L/bag, a theoretical/batch basis. Estimating density is dry-material consumption, not hardened coating density. Altex NZ Aug 2022 PDS distinguishes batch 3.5 ±15% from continuous mixing 4.1 ±15% kg/m²/cm; continuous nominal yield would be 41.46 L/bag. Confirm mixing method and site yield before use.
products.confidence: Qualified theoretical/batch basis; continuous mixing consumes more material.

products.basis: Reviewed 14 Sep 2026: current GCP Australia MK-6/HY PDS (29 Apr 2026), p5 gives 21.8 kg bags. GCP yield chart hosted by Trafalgar Australia (2016), p1 gives 27–28 board feet/bag uninjected; retain the lower 27 board feet = 63.71 L/bag. Estimating density is inferred dry-material consumption, not minimum installed density. Injection has a different yield. Older documents use 21.9 kg; the published per-bag yield has not been rescaled. Confirm delivered pack and application method; allow for site loss.
products.confidence: Conservative published uninjected estimate; verify current bag and site method.
